bioconda.name: bioconductor-beachmat
bioconda.summary: Compiling Bioconductor to Handle Each Matrix Type

biotools.summary: Provides a consistent C++ class interface for reading from a variety of commonly used matrix types. Ordinary matrices and several sparse/dense Matrix classes are directly supported, along with a subset of the delayed operations implemented in the DelayedArray package. All other matrix-like objects are supported by calling back into R.
